# DynamicAdaptivePhysicsGuidedGraphDiffusion

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A graph-based learning framework that dynamically adjusts diffusion parameters using physics-informed constraints to model spectral-spatial relationships in hyperspectral data. Enables topology-aware feature propagation that respects physical data structure, improving classification accuracy in complex spatial networks.
